symbols.name: Symbol_SetMargin

bindings.type: bool (WINAPI*)(MARGINS*, int, int, int, int, const MARGINS*)

symbols.notes: Paired IDA audits show no private RCX dependency after either direct SetMargin call on 22000.194 or 22621.1, so those builds use the ordinary C++ dispatcher. On 26100.1, 26100.7705, and 26100.8972, UpdateMarginsDependentOnStyle calls a three-argument wrapper whose third path consumes the preserved destination pointer from RCX through a later cmovz after the wrapper returns. Use the RCX-preserving physical dispatcher for build 26100 and later; keep replacement dispatch, the original call, and HookRundown release inside the preserved region.
